title: authz caching leg D: `getMetaItems` overlay cache keyed on the registry epoch — resolve the SchemaRegistry-hydration trap explicitly
body:
Leg **D** (ship second) of the accepted #11633 cross-request caching design. Provenance: design document = #11633 comment 5394942824 (§4 leg D, §10.2); maintainer acceptance = #11633 comment 5404681591 (2026-08-25, verbatim 「接受你的建议，继续」). Filed by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`.

**Content**: cross-request cache for `getMetaItems`' `sys_metadata` read, keyed on the registry epoch; reuses the shipped `metadata.changed` channel cross-node.

**Hard requirement**: the SchemaRegistry-hydration trap named in the design (§4 leg D) must be **resolved explicitly in the PR body** — stated and designed around, not inherited silently.

**Acceptance criterion**: "cached answer ≡ uncached answer" identity pin for `getMetaItems` across an epoch bump (write → epoch change → fresh read), per the design §7 pin plan.

Premise-first: design measured at `992161b728`; re-verify the epoch/channel seams on current `origin/main` before implementing.
